source_text: Vendor must indemnify Customer if a claim arises from Vendor's breach, except if the claim arises solely from Customer's misuse of the Software, in which case Vendor's indemnity obligation does not apply unless Customer had no knowledge of such misuse.
why_not_representable_in_v1: Multi-level nesting: a condition, containing an exception, containing a further exception. This is out of v1's scope under either candidate reading of 'conditions only' considered during this checkpoint -- it is nesting by any definition, not just a consequence of excluding UNLESS entirely. Included specifically to separate 'exceptions don't exist in v1' (exception-unless.json) from 'nesting/recursion across condition and exception constructs doesn't exist in v1' (this file) -- two related but distinct boundaries.
expected_parser_behavior: Parse failure routed through the repair loop, same as the simpler exception cases. A bounded repair loop (<=3 retries per blueprint SS6.3) is very unlikely to successfully simplify a three-level nested legal carve-out into valid v1 grammar -- this is exactly the kind of candidate expected to end up quarantined for human review, not repaired.
